summary: Count the zeroes of a polynomial by reading where its plotted curve meets the x-axis.
template: Given the graph of y = p(x), how many zeroes does p(x) have?

summary: Find the constant that makes two given linear equations have infinitely many solutions.
template: For which k do kx = y + {c1} and {a2}x = {b2}y + {c2} have infinitely many solutions?

topic: middle terms and conditions for AP
summary: Three expressions in p are consecutive AP terms; find p using the equal-difference condition.
template: If {expr1}, {expr2}, {expr3} are in AP, find p.

summary: Find the ratio in which the x-axis cuts the segment joining two given points.
template: In what ratio does the x-axis divide the segment joining A{pt1} and B{pt2}?

topic: angle and length problems with tangents
summary: Using a tangent and a central angle in a figure, find an angle between a chord and the tangent.
template: PQ touches a circle centred at O; given angle AOB = {x}, find angle ABQ.

summary: Given the value of tan A, evaluate a ratio of linear combinations of sin A and cos A.
template: If tan A = {value}, find ({a}sinA + {b}cosA)/({a}sinA - {b}cosA).

summary: Evaluate the sum of reciprocals of the zeroes of a given quadratic polynomial.
template: If alpha, beta are zeroes of {quadratic}, find 1/alpha + 1/beta.

summary: Find the smallest positive k for which a quadratic has rational roots (discriminant a perfect square).
template: Least positive k for which {quadratic with k} has rational roots.

summary: Evaluate an expression of squares of tan, sec and sin at standard angles.
template: Evaluate |tan^2 {A} - sec^2 {B} + sin^2 {C}|.

topic: NEW: curved surface area of a single solid
summary: Given the curved surface area and height of a cylinder, find its radius.
template: A cylinder of height {h} has curved surface area {S}; find the radius.

summary: From a 'less than' cumulative table, recover frequencies and identify the modal class.
template: Given a less-than cumulative distribution of {n} students, find the modal class.

topic: NEW: curved surface area of a single solid
summary: Compute the curved surface area of a cone from its radius and vertical height.
template: Find the curved surface area of a cone with height {h} and radius {r}.

summary: Find the distance between two given points, one on each axis.
template: Distance between {pt1} and {pt2}.

summary: Choose the quadratic polynomial having two given fractional zeroes.
template: Which quadratic polynomial has zeroes {z1} and {z2}?

summary: State the effect on the mean when every observation is raised by a constant.
template: If each observation is increased by {c}, what happens to the mean?

summary: Identify the relation between probability of an event and probability of its non-occurrence.
template: If P(event) = p and P(not event) = q, relate p and q.

summary: Given the winning probability and total tickets, find how many tickets she holds.
template: Probability of winning is {p}; with {N} tickets sold, how many were bought?

summary: Probability that a randomly chosen person from a group can swim, given how many cannot.
template: In a group of {n}, {k} cannot swim; P(person can swim)?

topic: NEW: axis intercepts and distance from axes
summary: Judge whether a point is where a line meets the y-axis and whether its distance from the x-axis is as stated.
template: Assertion: point {P} is where line {eq} meets y-axis; Reason: its distance from x-axis is {d}.

summary: Decide if the perimeter of a given triangle is rational and whether sum of squares of rationals is rational.
template: Assertion about rationality of triangle perimeter; Reason: sum of squares of two rationals is rational.

summary: Solve (or test consistency of) two simple equations graphically.
template: Solve x = {a}, y = {b} graphically, OR check consistency of {pair} by graph.

summary: Using a line parallel to BC and given segment lengths, find the length of XY.
template: In triangle ABC with XZ parallel to BC, AZ = {a}, ZC = {b}, BM = {c}, MC = {d}; find XY.

summary: Find a product of sin and cos from their given sum, OR sum of cosecs from two given ratios.
template: If sinθ + cosθ = {k}, find sinθ·cosθ; OR given sin α and cot β find cosec α + cosec β.

summary: Largest divisor of two numbers that leaves specified remainders.
template: Greatest number dividing {n1} and {n2} leaving remainders {r1}, {r2}.

summary: Find probabilities of drawing a red ball and a yellow ball from a bag with three colours.
template: A bag has {r} red, {b} blue, {y} yellow; find P(red) and P(yellow).

summary: Find two numbers from a condition on half their difference and another on greater plus twice smaller.
template: Half the difference of two numbers is {a}; greater plus twice smaller is {b}. Find them.

summary: Prove a given square root is irrational.
template: Prove that sqrt({p}) is irrational.

summary: Given two vertices of an equilateral triangle and that origin is inside, find the third vertex.
template: Two vertices {A},{B} of an equilateral triangle, origin inside; find third vertex (sqrt3 = {v}).

summary: Prove angle between tangents is twice angle OPQ, OR find radius of circle inscribed in a right-angled quadrilateral from given sides.
template: Tangents from T touch circle at P,Q: prove angle PTQ = 2 angle OPQ; OR find incircle radius given AD, AB, DS.

summary: Prove a tan/sec identity whose right side is (1+sinθ)/cosθ.
template: Prove (tanθ + secθ - 1)/(tanθ - secθ + 1) = (1+sinθ)/cosθ.

summary: Find total height of a cylinder-plus-dome room from its air volume, OR find ice-cream volume in a cone with hemispherical top.
template: Room of cylinder with hemisphere dome (radius half cylinder height) holds {V}; find height. OR cone filled with ice-cream except lower {f} of volume; find volume.

summary: Prove the basic proportionality theorem: a line parallel to one side divides the other two sides in equal ratio.
template: Prove that a line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally.

topic: heights and distances (single or two angles of elevation/depression)
summary: Two towers with given elevations: find distance, other tower height and wire length; OR prove a balloon's centre height is sqrt2 times radius.
template: Tower of height {h}, elevation {a} from other tower foot, {b} reverse; find distance, height, wire; OR spherical balloon subtending {x}, centre elevation {y}: prove height = sqrt2·r.

summary: Find areas of the minor and major segments cut by a chord subtending a given angle.
template: Chord of circle radius {r} subtends {θ} at centre; find minor and major segment areas.

summary: Given ratio of two terms, find ratio of other terms and sums, OR rows of logs in a stack forming an AP.
template: Ratio of {m}th to {n}th term is {p}:{q}; find ratio of other terms and of sums; OR {N} logs stacked in rows {a}, {a-1},... find rows and top row.

summary: A photo's dimensions each increased by x to double its area; form and solve the quadratic and check rationality of x for another area.
template: Photo {l}×{w} enlarged by x on both sides to double area; form equation, standardise, find new dimensions.

parts.label: ii
parts.summary: Convert it to standard quadratic form.

parts.label: iii
parts.summary: Find new dimensions; OR check if a rational x can give a different new area.

summary: Rainfall frequency table across sub-divisions: modal class, median (or mean), and count of good-rainfall regions.
template: Rainfall class table; find modal class, median/mean, and count with at least {threshold}.

parts.label: iii
parts.summary: Count sub-divisions with rainfall at least a given threshold.

summary: Discus thrown along a tangent: using tangent-radius right angle and a given angle at B, find AB, OB, AP (or PQ).
template: Tangent AB to circle radius {r} with angle ABO = {θ}; PQ parallel to OA; find AB, OB, AP or PQ.
